description: List releases for a repository. Returns a response envelope {releases, page, limit, count, has_next}. has_next true means a further page may exist; re-issue the call with page incremented to fetch it. The state filter is applied client-side after pagination, so count may be smaller than limit even when more matches exist on later pages.

state.description: Filter by state: all|draft|prerelease|published. Filter is applied client-side after pagination, so result size may be smaller than limit.

name: list_releases
